name: Modulated DSC of a frozen biopharmaceutical formulation: equilibration at -70 C and 1 C/min ramp to determine the glass transition of the freeze-concentrate
plain_name: Find the temperature at which a frozen medicine mixture softens
description: A liquid vaccine formulation is sealed in a hermetic Tzero pan, equilibrated at -70 C, held for 5 minutes and ramped at 1 C/min to 100 C with heat-cool temperature modulation, so that the glass transition of the maximally freeze-concentrated solution can be read from the reversing heat-flow signal. That transition sets the maximum allowable product temperature of the subsequent freeze-drying cycle.
keywords: Find the temperature at which a frozen medicine mixture softens

sources.citation: Lyophilization to enable distribution of ChAdOx1 and ChAdOx2 adenovirus-vectored vaccines without refrigeration, npj Vaccines 8, 83 (2023)

reported_equipment: Q2000 DSC (TA Instruments, Elstree, Herts, UK)
Tzero pan with Tzero hermetic lid (TA Instruments)

requirements.rationale: The measurement cycle runs from an equilibration at -70 C up to 100 C in one ramp, so the sample space must cover that whole span.
The glass transition of the freeze-concentrate is below -30 C, so the instrument must equilibrate at -70 C before the ramp begins.
The underlying heating ramp is 1 C/min (1000 mK/min); the machine must be able to drive at least that rate under control.
The readout is a modulated differential-scanning-calorimetry heat-flow signal, so the machine must be a DSC and not just a cold stage.
